In the background, other dishes like stir-fried scallions and beef are visible on a wooden table. (3) Rapid sequence of cooking: a chef tosses beef and vegetables in a wok over a high gas flame. Steam and smoke rise from the pan. (4) A black bowl is filled with fluffy white rice from a large commercial rice cooker. A ladle pours hot, clear soup into another black bowl. (5) A white paper cup is filled with a dark beverage from a cold drink dispenser. (6) Close-up shots of two dishes: stir-fried beef with green scallions and stir-fried beef with bitter melon. (7) A person uses metal tongs to pick fresh vegetables like cabbage and napa cabbage from a refrigerated display, placing them into a large clear plastic bowl. (8) Final sequence showing the interior of a clean restaurant with wooden tables, followed by an exterior shot of the storefront at night, featuring red decorations.
